text: This model guesses who earns above fifty thousand dollars a year, and it is wrong about some people far more often than others. Out of every hundred people who genuinely earn above that line, it finds about 85 in the Asian alone group and about 54 in the Some other race alone group, a recall gap of 0.312. Recall just means the share of qualifying people a model actually finds, so everyone it does not find is simply overlooked. Accuracy barely moves between those same groups, running from 0.77 to 0.84, which is why the single headline number most projects report would have hidden all of this. Giving each group its own cut-off was measured and would bring the gap down to 0.114 for 0.0042 of accuracy, and it was left unadopted anyway, because it needs to know the person's race at the moment it decides and it pushes the false alarm gap up instead.
source: drafted by Claude (Opus 5) in an editing session, verified by src/narrator.py before publication
